context_for_next_testing_agent: All mobile view and PPT download features verified working: 1) Login page renders correctly on 390x844 mobile viewport with bearing, colorful title, pull cord. 2) Pull cord click reveals login form that stacks below content on mobile. 3) Login works with manoj@capex.com/capex123 and admin@capex.com/admin123. 4) Dashboard shows hamburger menu button (data-testid='mobile-menu-btn') on mobile. 5) Hamburger menu opens Sheet sidebar drawer. 6) Dashboard content is scrollable. 7) Settings page tabs use grid-cols-2 on small screens. 8) PPT download endpoint /api/download/user-manual-ppt returns 200 with application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation content-type and 59KB file. 9) Settings > Help tab shows 'User Manual (PPT)' card with download button (data-testid='download-ppt-btn'). 10) Admin panel works on mobile with tabs that wrap (flex-wrap) and scroll (overflow-x-auto). 11) Admin login navigates to /admin. Note: Tutorial modal appears on first login which can block UI interactions - use 'Skip Tutorial' button.
